name: Scooch
title: Scooch moves your wallpaper out from under your icons
description: Scooch moves your own wallpaper so desktop icons never cover the best part of the picture. Any image, on macOS, Windows and Linux.

beats.title: Wallpaper that scooches over for your icons.
Icons always land on the best part of the picture.
Scooch finds the subject with plain image math.
beats.support: No AI and no model files.

beats.title: Then it moves the picture so nothing important is covered.
Move an icon and the wallpaper follows.
Between changes it draws nothing.
beats.support: While it sleeps it uses no CPU and very little memory.

beats.title: Any picture. Mac, Windows and Linux.

facts: Works with the picture you already have.

alt: An old beige laptop open on a metal desk at night under an orange arm lamp. The screen shows a fox photo with desktop icons over its head.
Close on the laptop screen. Desktop icons sit right on the fox's face.
The screen turns into a map of where the picture matters, with the fox glowing warm on a dark field.
The fox photo has moved over so the icons sit on plain sky.
A pointer drags one icon across the screen and the picture shifts again after the drop.
The lamp is off and the laptop screen is the only light on the desk.
A wide shot of the desk with the lamp back on low.
